comments.body:
Can be plundered from Karim Lv40, who hangs out in the Ustyurt Plateau which is accessed from the Black Sea (no pre-discovery needed to enter unlike most inland zones). Stats:

20 Disguise
Theology +2
Archaeology +1
4k total fame to equip, unisex.

Source/pics: tyojyuhei.web.fc2.com/dol_body.html | fashionamagiya.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1464.html
